scope: All metrics outcome-conditioned on 170 current V2 improvements unless explicitly subset
match: score equality within 1e-12; prediction equality separately measured
recovery: (R2-SB)/(Native-SB), unclipped; ratio-of-sums differs from mean per-sample recovery
adjacent: number of samples with at least one adjacent successful tau within the SAME ordered action pair; isolated is remaining matched-multi samples
reversal: A^tau B^(T-tau) compared to B^(T-tau) A^tau; all matched candidates, sample-equal mean; selected-set contrast subject to selection bias
global_weighting: 48678 unordered pairs; first mean within sample then across170; not pooled candidate weighting
prediction_hash: equality of recorded decoded prediction only, not state equivalence
